stage.definition: A specific identifiable position in a continuum or series or especially in a process.

podium.definition: A platform raised above the surrounding level to give prominence to the person on it.

microphone.definition: A device that changes sound into an electrical recording or signal.
microphone.exampleUsage: The microphone was used during the activity.

speech.definition: The act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience.

diploma.definition: A document certifying the successful completion of a course of study.

handshake.definition: Grasping and shaking a person's hand (as to acknowledge an introduction or to agree on a contract).

procession.definition: An organized line of people entering or moving during a ceremony.

recessional.definition: The procession in which participants leave at the end of a ceremony.

applause.definition: A demonstration of approval by clapping the hands together.

cap.definition: An upper limit on what is allowed.

gown.definition: A long formal robe worn for a graduation ceremony.

tassel.definition: Adornment consisting of a bunch of cords fastened at one end.

honor-cord.definition: A colored cord worn with academic dress to recognize a particular achievement, organization, or distinction.
honor-cord.exampleUsage: The graduate wore an honor cord over the gown.

stole.definition: A long narrow decorative garment worn over the shoulders at graduation.

sash.definition: A broad strip of cloth worn across the body as ceremonial clothing.

dress-shoes.definition: Shoes designed for formal or smart clothing.
dress-shoes.exampleUsage: He wore dress shoes with the graduation outfit.

class-ring.definition: A ring designed to represent a graduating class, school, or year.
class-ring.exampleUsage: The class ring displayed the school emblem.

pin.definition: A number you choose and use to gain access to various accounts.

medal.definition: An award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event.

cap-toss.definition: A celebratory tradition in which graduates throw academic caps into the air together.
cap-toss.exampleUsage: The graduates gathered outdoors for a supervised cap toss.

yearbook.definition: A book published annually by the graduating class of a high school or college usually containing photographs of faculty and graduating students.

class-photo.definition: A photograph showing members of a class or graduating group together.
class-photo.exampleUsage: The graduates posed for a class photo.

valedictorian.definition: The student with the best grades who usually delivers the valedictory address at commencement.

salutatorian.definition: A graduating student with the second highest academic rank.

honors.definition: Special academic recognition for strong achievement.

cum-laude.definition: Awarded to a student whose academic work has earned special recognition.

alumni.definition: People who previously attended or graduated from a school or university.

alma-mater.definition: The school or university from which you graduated.
alma-mater.arabicTranslation: الجامعة أو المدرسة التي تخرج منها الشخص

commencement.definition: A ceremony celebrating students' completion of their studies.

party.definition: A gathering of people for pleasure.

cake.definition: A sweet baked food that may be decorated or filled.

balloons.definition: Large tough nonrigid bag filled with gas or heated air.

banner.definition: A long piece of fabric or paper displaying words or images.

gift.definition: Something given freely to another person.

card.definition: A card certifying the identity of the bearer.

flowers.definition: The colorful parts of plants, often given as a gift.

champagne.definition: A white sparkling wine either produced in Champagne or resembling that produced there.
champagne.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Champagne" in an educational description.

toast.definition: A short speech wishing someone success or happiness before a drink.

dinner.definition: A party of people assembled to have dinner together.

degree.definition: An award conferred by a college or university signifying that the recipient has satisfactorily completed a course of study.

major.definition: Of greater importance or stature or rank.

minor.definition: Of lesser importance or stature or rank.

gpa.definition: A measure of a student's academic achievement at a college or university.

thesis.definition: A treatise advancing a new point of view resulting from research.

dissertation.definition: A treatise advancing a new point of view resulting from research.

semester.definition: One of two divisions of an academic year.

credit.definition: A unit awarded for completing a course of study.

dean.definition: The head of a faculty or school within a university.

proud.definition: Feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth.

excited.definition: Feeling eager and happy about something that is going to happen.

nervous.definition: Of or relating to the nervous system.

nostalgic.definition: Unhappy about being away and longing for familiar things or persons.

job-search.definition: The process of looking for employment opportunities and applying for suitable roles.
job-search.exampleUsage: The career center supports graduates during the job search.

graduate-school.definition: A university division or program offering advanced study after a bachelor's degree.
graduate-school.exampleUsage: She plans to apply to graduate school next year.

internship.definition: A supervised period of practical work experience, often undertaken during training.

gap-year.definition: A planned period, often about a year, taken between stages of education or work for activities such as travel, service, or personal development.
gap-year.exampleUsage: He is considering a gap year before university.

moving.definition: Causing strong feelings, especially sympathy or sadness.
